CanBeGeneratedInCombat.maps_to: NOT PORTED -- the shared `_ChoosableCurse` base sets `can_be_generated_by_modifiers = False` instead (knowledge_curses.py:26)
CanBeGeneratedInCombat.issue: `public override bool CanBeGeneratedInCombat => false` (MindRot.cs:14) has no counterpart; the sim leaves `can_be_generated_in_combat` True and turns off a different flag that MindRot.cs does not override. Identical to card/disintegration's and card/frantic_escape's entries and carrying the same verdict (rule 3). DORMANT both ways: `pool_card_ids()` (IRONCLAD_POOL) holds no Status cards, and the random-CURSE pool holds no Status-rarity cards either.

ctor.issue: STATUS / STATUS / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses, statuses or quests.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<MindRotPower>(1m)` (MindRot.cs:18) == `default_power_amount = 1`, copied into `self.power_amount` by `_init_vars` so it is re-seeded on downgrade.

OnChosen.maps_to: _ChoosableCurse's power application via CombatState.select_cards (knowledge_curses.py module docstring; the chooser is the Knowledge Demon)
OnChosen.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<MindRotPower>(new ThrowingPlayerChoiceContext(), Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["MindRotPower"].IntValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (MindRot.cs:25-28) == the sim's select-then-apply path reading `power_cls` and `power_amount` off the chosen card. Self-target, self-applier, amount 1. `KnowledgeDemon.IChoosable` is an interface rather than a CardModel override, so the harness's `public override` scan does not enumerate it -- added by hand.

OnPlay.rationale: MindRot.cs declares no OnPlay. See card/disintegration's guard for the playability-flag finding, which applies identically to all four Knowledge-Demon cards.

guards.what: the sim marks the card `is_playable = False` (knowledge_curses.py:23); MindRot.cs declares NO Unplayable keyword
guards.issue: C# gives this Status no CanonicalKeywords at all, so in the game it is a PLAYABLE no-effect Status -- the same shape as card/beckon, which the sim does model as playable. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/disintegration's guard (rule 3). DORMANT: the four Knowledge-Demon cards never reach a pile on either side.
